hardening_status: Runtime claims must distinguish implemented, structural candidate, and planned/audio-unverified behavior.

status_semantics.native_first: Ableton already solves the mechanical job; N0TE should orchestrate/contextualize rather than duplicate it.
status_semantics.n0te_core: Core N0TE responsibility; implementation completeness must be verified in BUILD_VALIDATION.md.
status_semantics.n0te_additive: N0TE adds a capability/workflow layer; may be partial/planned.
status_semantics.hybrid: Use native mechanisms plus N0TE context/reasoning.
status_semantics.future_external: Later external capability; not Song-Ready blocking.
status_semantics.future_transport: Later transport option; not Song-Ready blocking.
status_semantics.implemented: Implemented and automatically validated; external acceptance may still be separately required.
status_semantics.partially_implemented: A working tested subset exists, with explicitly documented integration work remaining.
status_semantics.interface_only: Contracts/scaffolding exist, but no real integration is claimed.
status_semantics.external_acceptance_pending: Implementation exists but requires real external system or hardware acceptance.

song_ready_status.reason: Gate 1 ownership, recovery, Apply revalidation, diagnostics, persistence/concurrency, API and CI controls are implemented and covered by automated regressions. SONG-READY remains pending the disposable real-Live checklist.
blocking_items: user completion of the Gate 1 disposable real-Live acceptance checklist
